review_panel.finding: Audited contracts/examples/institutional-policy.yaml, data-handling-request.yaml and data-handling-decision.yaml against crates/searchright-governance/src/lib.rs::evaluate. Verified policy, request and decision identifiers agree, deployment mode, classification, retention and region sit inside policy limits, and a dry-run on restricted full text is permitted but still flags human_approval_required.

Verified evaluate() records a stable governance.* blocker for each denied deployment mode, classification, retention overrun, telemetry, full-text persistence, external model, cross-border transfer, region, multi-tenant isolation and non-public export condition, and permits a request only when no blocker was recorded.

Verified Confidential, RestrictedFullText and SensitivePersonalData requests require recorded human approval, lifecycle apply requires an approval bound to the exact principal, policy and request digest, expiry is enforced, the approval registry is bounded, and LifecycleAuthorization keeps its fields private so authority cannot be forged outside the verifier path.

Audited crates/searchright-screening/src/lib.rs. ScreeningBoard::resolve requires the Adjudicator role, a live conflict, a complete set of human decision identifiers, an adjudicator who is not one of the original reviewers and a round that is not already finalised; agent decisions are excluded from the human decision set.

Exercised scripts/redaction.py with an adversarial payload. Secrets, URL user information, query text and contact addresses are removed deterministically while safe endpoint controls (db, retmax) are retained. De-identification of arbitrary free text is not claimed.
Upgraded T28-A001 through T28-A005 to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete symbols in conductor/traceability-overrides.json and the track traceability.json.
